slides.title: Where we are
items: We start the final project today: a system of your own design, with at least two sensors and two actuators, that your phone can talk to over Bluetooth.

In the reading we introduced Bluetooth Low Energy: what BLE is for, how a peripheral and a central find each other (GAP, the Generic Access Profile), how they exchange data once connected (GATT, the Generic Attribute Profile), and how the Bluefruit module turns all of that into a serial connection.
Today we'll look at what it takes to talk to the Bluefruit module from your Nucleo, and then you will have time to work on your project.
